events.title: Update: 8 New Languages
events.summary: Guild of the Tower now supports 10 languages.This update adds full translations for:FrenchGermanSpanish (Spain)Portuguese (Brazil)RussianJapaneseSimplified ChineseTraditional ChineseThey join English and Thai. Every menu, tutorial, tooltip, quest, item, monster name and boss conversation is translated.How to switchThe game picks your system language the first time you launch it. You can change it any time in Options > Language.About the translationsThese translations were made with AI assistance

events.title: Demo Update: A Whole New Look, and We're in Steam Next Fest
events.summary: Guild of the Tower will be part of Steam Next Fest, October 19 to 26. To get ready, we rebuilt almost every screen in the game. If you tried the demo before, it will look very different now.New interfaceHero Info: all five tabs redesigned. A stat chart with growth projection, equipment slots around your hero with live stat comparison, a full skill tree view, and a relationship web.Gambit editor: each rule is now a row of color-coded chips. Click a chip to change just that part of the rule.Tower

events.title: Steam Party-Based RPG FEST and New Demo Version
events.summary: We have updated the demo to a new version in celebration of the Steam Party-Based RPG FEST. We have adjusted the game balance, fixed bugs, and added quality-of-life improvements to the latest demo version.We hope you enjoy the experience. Of course, if you have any further suggestions or encounter any bugs, please feel free to leave a comment.

New Gambit conditions. You can now require a minimum number of allies to match a condition before a command fires, which finally makes party wide heals and buffs practical. events.title: Demo available now! 10 floors, free
events.summary: You never control your heroes directly in combat. Instead you write the rules they follow like FFXII gambit style and watch whether your logic holds. Permadeath, so usually it doesn't hold forever. Around that: recruit heroes with randomly rolled traits, assign them to the forge, alchemy lab, or training grounds, and run a guild across a day cycle where mood, fatigue, and wages all matter.
